---
title: "Survival guide for degrees"
description: "Some tips to help undergraduate students make the most of their studies and pass all their subjects."
date: 2017-04-24
categories: [Teaching]
image: featured.jpg
---

Practical advice for university students, especially in their first years:
be self-motivated, take a proactive role in your own learning, see your
teacher as an ally rather than an adversary, make the most of classes and
tutoring hours, read and write beyond what's given in class, work in groups,
and review your progress regularly.
